properties.description:
Cut 2026-09-13, a patch over v0.60.0. One CI script fix; no change to the tool surface, the schema, or any behaviour of the server.

WHY IT EXISTS: v0.60.0's binaries, kit and checksums published correctly and its CONTAINER IMAGE DID NOT. The image smoke test's new two-design phase failed on the release runner, and that gate runs BEFORE anything is published — so it correctly refused to ship an unverified image rather than publishing one. This release republishes everything, image included.

THE DEFECT WAS IN THE TEST, NOT THE PRODUCT. The mint loop checked `{{.State.Running}}` and broke out when it was false, which it is for the first moment of every container's life; on a slower runner it reported "nothing to isolate" without ever having waited. It passed locally and failed in CI — a check-then-act found in the worst place.
properties.name: v0.60.1 — the image smoke test stops giving up before it has minted anything
